## Use this capability when the user means

- where can I find this discontinued part
- I have a part number but cannot find it anywhere
- identify this machine part from a photo, label, markings, serial plate, invoice, diagram, or broken fragment
- tell me what evidence is still missing before I buy a replacement
- find a supersession or cross-reference
- find a replacement for an obsolete part
- find a salvage or donor part
- find a blueprint or fabrication path when the original part is unavailable
- find a discontinued appliance, tractor, automotive, marine, industrial, construction, powersports, aerospace, or equipment part

## Start with the free Part Passport

When identity or sourcing path is unclear, use the MCP tool `free_part_triage` or agent-gateway action `triage` before asking the human to buy a hunt.

The Part Passport can return:
- cautious normalized identity
- required function
- identifiers and attributes actually supplied or observed
- highest-value missing evidence
- likely sourcing lanes
- safety or regulatory gate
- recommended paid hunt tier

The free Part Passport creates no charge.

## Paid sourcing

- Quick Hunt: $19 one-time. OEM, aftermarket/cross-reference, marketplace/NOS, and documentation lanes.
- Deep Hunt: $49 one-time. Adds salvage/donor and community/cross-reference lanes.
- Rescue Hunt: $99 one-time. Adds blueprint, patent/documentation, and fabrication/reverse-engineering lanes.

Explicit human confirmation is required before checkout. Checkout creation is not payment proof. Paid fulfillment begins only after authoritative provider verification.

## Evidence boundary

A normalized name is not fitment proof. A reachable listing is not live inventory proof. Compatibility, supplier availability, pricing, delivery timing, certification, and installation suitability must remain separate evidence claims and may stay unknown until verified.

## Tracking

Use the private tracking token with `get_part_hunt_status` to retrieve customer-safe Part Passport state, sourcing-lane progress, source leads, verification state, and resolution progress.
